title: CleaveNet designs peptide substrates with MMP13 cleavage profiles
summary: CleaveNet combines a generative model conditioned on protease cleavage profiles with a predictor that ranks candidate sequences. In an in-vitro screen of 95 peptide substrates against 12 matrix metalloproteinases, the authors report that designed substrates were cleaved by MMP13 and identify substrates with different efficiency/selectivity trade-offs. The panel includes training controls and baseline candidates; it is not 95 novel AI discoveries. These are laboratory substrates, not validated diagnostic or therapeutic products.
ai_technology: CleaveNet generator and predictor; deep learning

evidence.tested: The paper reports the specific in-vitro protein assay summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Clinical or diagnostic deployment and independent replication are not established.
evidence.ai_role: A generator proposes peptide sequences conditioned on cleavage profiles; a model ranks candidates and researchers test synthetic substrates against recombinant enzymes.

source_review.scope: Full primary journal article text, results and experimental assays reviewed. The preprint version-specific claim correspondence was not checked.
